'''Kren Sallo''' was a resident of [[Vaklin]] and took part in the [[Vaklin insurgency|uprising]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces that took place after the [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was issued. During that time, Kren was collecting donations for the uprising at the local [[Cantina/Legends|canteen]].
